{{Top}} {{FAnom}} {{CelestialBody |image=[[File:Varkana-TheMissingAgent.png]] |name=Varkana |region=*[[Outer Rim Territories]][[Bounty Hunters 30|''Bounty Hunters'' 30]] *[[New Territories]]{{StarWarsGalaxyMap}} places Varkana in the area of [[Realspace|space]] ''[[Star Wars: The Galactic Explorer's Guide]]'' identifies as the [[New Territories]]. |sector=[[Quelii sector]]{{GalaxyMapAppendix}} — Based on corresponding data for the [[Varkana system]] |system=[[Varkana system]]{{Resistance|The Missing Agent}} |coordinates=[[Standard Galactic Grid|O-6]]{{GalaxyMapPoster}} |xyz=325.04, 311.41, -8.2{{DatapadCite|Port of Call: Varkana|Varkana-GSDatapad.png|gs=yes}} |distance= |suns= |orbited= |position= |moons= |routes=[[Salin Corridor]]{{GalaxyMapHyperlanes|route=[[Salin Corridor]]|canon=''[[Nexus of Power]]''|leg=''[[The Essential Atlas]]''}} |lengthday= |lengthyear= |class=Terrestrial |diameter= |atmosphere=[[Atmosphere|Type I]] {{C|breathable}}{{Resistance|The Missing Agent}} establishes that Varkana had a breathable [[atmosphere]] that {{BuildFalconCite|43|Secrets of Spaceflight}} classifies as Type I. |climate=*Arid *Rain{{Resistance|Breakout}} *Lightning storms |gravity= |terrain= |water= |interest=*[[Darrb's house]] *[[Losha Tarkon's cantina]] |flora= |fauna= |otherlife= |species= |otherspecies=*[[Gabdorin]] *[[Gran]] *[[Human]] *A [[Unidentified species (Varkana)|humanoid species]] *[[Morseerian]] *[[Sakiyan]] |socialgroup= |language= |government= |population= |demonym= |cities=[[Vargo Spaceport]] |imports= |exports= |affiliation= }} {{Quote|I finally have enough credits to get off this stinking planet.|Lechee|audio=OffVarkana-TheMissingAgent.flac|}} '''Varkana''' was a rocky [[desert]] [[planet]] located in the [[Outer Rim Territories]]. It included the port village [[Vargo Spaceport]], where the [[human]] [[Losha Tarkon]] operated a [[Losha Tarkon's cantina|cantina]]. The [[cantina]] was visited by the [[Nautolan]] [[bounty hunter]] [[Nakano Lash]] and her [[Nakano Lash's crew|crew]] around [[10 BBY]]. By [[34 ABY]], the [[Resistance]] [[spy]] [[Norath Kev]] operated on Varkana and tracked the [[First Order]]'s activity and connections there. That [[Standard year|year]], he was reported by a [[Lechee|local vendor]] and captured by the [[bounty]] [[Hunting|hunter]] [[Ax Tagrin]]. A [[distress signal]] activated by Kev came to the attention of fellow Resistance spy [[Kazuda Xiono]], who put together a group that [[Rescue of Norath Kev|travelled]] to Vargo Spaceport in search of Kev. Tagrin confronted the group, but they got away after a brief skirmish and managed to located the bounty hunter's [[Dalkor Dagger|starship]] in order to find Kev. When Xiono and two of his companions boarded the [[Novahawk-class assault transport|ship]] and freed Kev, Tagrin trapped them aboard the [[Starship|vessel]] and tried to rendezvous with the First Order. However, Tagrin's captives were able to crash the ship on the inside, and while the bounty hunter continued to pursue them, Xiono and Kev got away while their associates were captured. With the First Order arriving, Xiono's comrades were interrogated for information, but the two Resistance spies were able to disguise themselves as [[First Order stormtrooper]]s and free their allies. While Tagrin attempted to stop them from escaping, they defeated the bounty hunter and fled Varkana. ==Description== {{Quote|Look around. There's nothing of much value in this place.|Synara San|audio=NotMuchValue-TheMissingAgent.flac|}} [[File:Varkana-CLNE.png|thumb|left|300px|Varkana was located just off of the Salin Corridor hyperspace route.]] Varkana was a terrestrial [[planet]] located in an [[Varkana system|eponymous star system]] within the [[New Territories]] portion of the [[Outer Rim Territories]] region. It lay in the [[Quelii sector]] just off of the''[[Star Wars: Complete Locations, New Edition]]'' [[Salin Corridor]] [[hyperspace route]] between the [[Botajef system|Botajef]] and [[Vinsoth system]]s. Varkana was situated at the [[galactic coordinates]] 325.04, 311.41, -8.2 and in the grid square O-6 on the [[Standard Galactic Grid]]. Appearing bronze-[[color]]ed from above, Varkana's surface was characterized by rocky [[desert]]s with cliffs, canyons, and spires. With a Type I [[atmosphere]] breathable to [[human]]s and other [[alien]] [[species]], it had a dry climate with little vegetation, but could host rain and lightning storms. ==History== ===A toast to companions=== {{Quote|You do see me waiting by the bar, right, ''T'ongor?'' I'm good for my round.''"
"''I saw you ignore two bartenders who came up to you. And I need something to drink—before ''Bossk'' gets us kicked out of this place.|T'onga and T'ongor|[[Bounty Hunters 30|''Bounty Hunters'' 30]]}} [[File:LashsCrewVarkana-BountyHunters30.png|thumb|right|300px|Nakano Lash holds a meeting with her crew on Varkana around 10 BBY.]] By around [[10 BBY]],The flashback events of [[Bounty Hunters 30|''Bounty Hunters'' 30]] that take place on Varkana occur between [[Beilert Valance]]'s discharge from the [[Galactic Empire]] and the [[Mission to Corellia (Nakano Lash's crew)|skirmish on Corellia]], which ''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' places in [[10 BBY]] and around 10 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|BBY]], respectively. The events on Varkana must therefore also take place around that [[Standard year|year]]. the human [[Losha Tarkon]] owned a [[Losha Tarkon's cantina|cantina]] at the village [[Vargo Spaceport]] on Varkana, working there as a one of the [[bartender]]s. Around that [[Standard year|year]], a [[Nakano Lash's crew|crew]] of [[bounty hunter]]s led by the [[Nautolan]] [[Nakano Lash]] visited the cantina for a briefing. While one of the crew, the [[Trandoshan]] [[Bossk'wassak'Cradossk|Bossk]], got into a fight with other patrons, another member, the human [[T'onga]], was getting a round of [[Alcohol|drinks]] for the group, becoming distracted by Tarkon. When her[[Bounty Hunters 34|''Bounty Hunters'' 34]] [[twin]][[Bounty Hunters 1|''Bounty Hunters'' 1]] [[Gender|brother]] [[T'ongor]] went to see what was taking her so long, he realized the reason decided he would have to sort his own drink himself. Lash soon started the briefing with her crew, highlighting the importance of the [[bounty]] [[Hunting|hunters]] working together amongst the harsh banter between some of the other crewmembers. T'onga joined the meeting partway through and the crew toasted to companionship at the end. By [[3 ABY]],''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of [[Bounty Hunters 1|''Bounty Hunters'' 1]] to [[3 ABY]]. Tarkon had relocated to the [[moon]] of [[Logal Ri]] with[[Bounty Hunters 1|''Bounty Hunters'' 1]] her now [[Marriage|wife]] T'onga.[[Bounty Hunters 3|''Bounty Hunters'' 3]] ===Spy activity=== ====Call for help==== {{Quote|I was tracking the shipments and materials the First Order moves through black market channels.''"
"''Until Lechee double-crossed you.''"
"''Greed got the best of him. I had a whole list of names. First Order sympathizers and dealers.|Norath Kev and Kazuda Xiono|audio=NorathsMission-TheMissingAgent.flac|}} [[File:NorathKevDistressSignal-TheMissingAgent.png|thumb|left|300px|Norath Kev tracked First Order activity on Varkana]] By [[34 ABY]],{{ResistanceDate|2|12}} the [[Resistance]] [[spy]] [[Norath Kev]] operated at Vargo Spaceport, monitoring [[black market]] shipments there. Intent on tracking [[First Order]] activity, the spy accumulated a list of individuals on Varkana working for the First Order as dealers or collaborators. However, the junk [[Merchant|vendor]] [[Lechee]] discovered Kev's ties and reported him to the First Order. [[Ax Tagrin]], a bounty hunter tasked with capturing Resistance operatives for the First Order, was sent to capture the spy. Kev and his [[droid]] [[2BR-NTB]] were pursued to a building, where the spy hit a [[datapad]] with all of his intelligence and activated a [[distress signal]] on it. Tagrin arrived and destroyed 2BR-NTB, taking Kev [[prisoner]]. Set on using the distress signal as bait for more Resistance targets, the bounty hunter kept Kev on his [[starship]], the [[Novahawk-class assault transport]] ''[[Dalkor Dagger]]'',''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' in a rented docking bay. Kev's distress call was picked up by the ''[[Colossus]]'', a [[supertanker fuel depot]] that was [[Hunt for the Colossus|on the run]] from the First Order. To the reluctance of [[Captain]] [[Imanuel Doza]], [[Kazuda Xiono]], a Resistance spy working with the ''Colossus'', led a mission to investigate the distress signal. He was joined by his droid [[CB-23]], fellow Resistance operative [[Jarek Yeager]], and the [[pirate]] [[Synara San]]. The group landed just outside Vargo Spaceport in a [[Star Commuter 2000]], making their way to the building where Kev had left his [[distress beacon]]. While they travelled there, Lechee spotted the visitors and tried to haggle them for business. Being turned down, the junk vendor contacted Tagrin, reporting on the visitors. ====Tagrin's traps==== {{Quote|Snagged three more members of the Resistance, Pyre. My usual rate applies.''"
"''Of course. The First Order thanks you for your service to our cause.|Ax Tagrin reports to Commander Pyre|audio=AxPyre-TheMissingAgent.flac|}} [[File:Tagrin-confrontation-MA.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Ax Tagrin confronts Kazuda Xiono and Jarek Yeager]] Finding where Kev had been captured, Xiono's group recovered the datapad, uncovering the spy's findings, identifying Lechee on the list of First Order affiliates. Before they could leave, though, Tagrin confronted them, leading to a skirmish as San engaged the bounty hunter to allow the rest to escape. San and Tagrin continued to fight outside the building, but the bounty hunter ended up escaping after hurting his pirate adversary. Xiono and his companions regrouped in a marketplace, discussing the situation and making brief contact with the ''Colossus''. With Xion keen on finding Kev, they went to confront Lechee, who had received a sum of [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]] for his informant work. Interrogating the vendor, they were able to determine the location of Tagrin's ship. San destroyed Lechee's [[comlink]] as they departed. After the group arrived at the docking bay, San kept watch outside while the rest of the group boarded the ''Dalkor Dagger'' to find Kev. Xiono found the captured spy and helped him out of his cell, only to find it was a trap as Tagrin closed the boarding ramp to the ship, enclosing them on board. Contacting [[Commander]] [[Pyre]] of the First Order, Tagrin took off and departed Vargo Spaceport. However, Xiono and his companions found a way to overload the ''Dalkor Dagger''{{'s}} systems from the inside, crashing it. As the Resistance operatives tried to escape the crash site, both CB-23 and Kev being damaged or injured, Tagrin pursued them again and overpowered Xiono and Yeager. San arrived on a [[speeder bike]] and joined the fight, allowing Xiono and Kev to escape on the [[speeder]], but as she and Yeager kept Tagrin at bay, the bounty hunter used his [[vibro-ax]] to take them down, capturing them and CB-23. ====First Order crackdown==== {{Quote|What is your status?''"
"''A bounty hunter caught Yeager, Synara, and CB and turned them over to the First Order. Where are you?''"
"''I've powered down the ''Colossus'', and we are hidden within some electrical interference, but it's only a matter of time before their patrols spot us.''"
"''Hold out as long as you can, Captain. We have a plan. We're gonna get everyone back soon.''"
"''Hurry, Kaz. If we run into trouble up here, we may have to jump away without you.|Imanuel Doza and Kazuda Xiono|audio=XionoDozaReport-Breakout.flac|}} [[File:TiernyYeagerSan-Breakout.png|thumb|left|300px|Jarek Yeager and Synara San were interrogated by Agent Tierny.]] Meanwhile, the First Order [[Resurgent-class Star Destroyer|''Resurgent''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Thunderer]]'', [[Commanding officer|commanded]] by Pyre, arrived in Varkana's [[orbit]], sending down [[TIE/fo space superiority fighter]]s and [[AAL-1971/9.1 Troop Transport]]s carrying [[First Order stormtrooper]]s to Vargo Spaceport. As Xiono contacted Doza for an evacuation, the captain said that it was too late, confirming the First Order's arrival. Pyre and First Order [[agent]] [[Tierny]] joined the forces deploying to Vargo Spaceport in an [[Upsilon-class command shuttle|''Upsilon''-class command shuttle]], disembarking to meet Tagrin and the prisoners. Tagrin was promised no payment until the Xiono and Kev were captured too. Tierny took the new prisoners away for interrogation. Xiono and Kev evaded stormtroopers that were sweeping Vargo Spaceport, briefly making contact again with the ''Colossus'', which was hiding in the electrical storm of a nearby moon. Xiono lied to Doza that he had a plan to save his team, but when Kev questioned what the plan was, he revealed he was still trying to formulate one. Pyre had a [[tech stormtrooper]] on trying to break into the databanks of CB-23 while Tierny [[torture]]d San and Yeager and information on the ''Colossus'' and the Resistance in one of the [[troop transport]]s, taunting them. As the two Resistance spies kept sneaking around, Xiono decided that they should disguise themselves as stormtroopers, much to Kev's doubts. A couple of stormtroopers then found and pursued the pair, who tried to hide in the [[Darrb's house|residence]] of the vendor [[Darrb]]. A reluctant Darrb was able to get the stormtroopers' attention, but the spies managed to incapacitate the troopers and carry them away. ====The escape==== {{Quote|If we stay here any longer, those troopers will eventually find us.''"
"''Back to the shuttle.|San and Xiono|audio=BackToShuttle-Breakout.flac|}} Disguising themselves in the stormtroopers' armour, Xiono and Kev slowly made their way towards the First Order transports, flimsily blending in among the other troopers around. Tagrin identified the pair in their disguises and chose to infiltrate their [[shuttle]], contacting the ''Colossus'' in order to reveal its hiding location. After Tagrin informed the First Order, the ''Thunderer'' attempted to intercept the [[refueling station]], which ended up escaping into [[hyperspace]]. Tierny had been called over to CB-23's holding site by Pyre, who left her there when hearing the ''Colossus'' had escaped. Pyre then ran into the disguised Xiono and Kev at the building entrance, being [[stun]]ned when the pair failed to stay in character. As the tech stormtrooper successfully accessed CB-23's databanks, Tierny left them to it, but the droid was able to shock the trooper and wipe the consoles. When Tierny returned to the scene, the droid knocked her unconscious too. [[File:NorathKazudaRescuing-Breakout.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Xiono and Kev rescued their companions disguised in stormtrooper armour.]] As that happened, Xiono and Kev found and freed Yeager and San, with CB-23 joining them too. Before any more troopers could find them, they quickly made their way out of the docking bay and back to their shuttle. However, Tagrin had stayed there and tried to capture them, cornering them outside the shuttle. CB-23, though, took control of the shuttle and used it to take the bounty hunter down. As Pyre and two other troopers arrived, Xiono's group was able to board their shuttle and make away on it. On the commander's orders, First Order [[TIE series|TIEs]] tried to pursue the shuttle, but the ''Colossus''{{'s}} [[Ace Squadron]] arrived and fended the enemy ships off. When the ''Thunderer'' tried to cut them off in orbit, the ''Colossus'' arrived out of hyperspace to quickly pick them up and jump away again, leaving Pyre's forces empty-handed. Later the same year,''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of [[Star Wars: Galactic Starcruiser|''Star Wars'': Galactic Starcruiser]] to [[34 ABY]]. the [[Chandrila Star Line]]'s [[MPO-1400 Purgill-class star cruiser|MPO-1400 ''Purgill''-class star cruiser]] ''[[Halcyon]]'', which had departed from the [[Core Worlds]] planet''[[Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge: Treasures from Batuu]]'' [[Chandrila]] made an unscheduled detour to Vargo Spaceport to pick up a shipment of [[blaster]]s. The shipment was to be delivered to Kev on the Outer Rim planet [[Mon Cala]]. The pickup and subsequent delivery of the shipment was included in the [[Star Cruiser|cruiser's]] port of call schedule, was detailed in the voyage's datapad crew notes. The notes indicated that an [[Aide|attendant]] at Vargo Spaceport would have useful intelligence on the task. ==Inhabitants== {{Quote|We'll park just outside of the port. No need to attract any unwanted attention.|Jarek Yeager|audio=NoUnwantedAttention-TheMissingAgent.flac|}} On Varkana, a multitude of species roamed the streets of Vargo Spaceport, including [[Gabdorin]]s, [[Gran]], humans, [[Morseerian]]s, [[Sakiyan]]s, and another [[Unidentified species (Varkana)|humanoid species]]. ==Locations== {{Quote|He rented out a docking bay in the main hangar on the south side, all right?|Lechee reveals where Tagrin is keeping his ship|audio=DockingBaySouthSide-TheMissingAgent.flac|}} Varkana was home to Vargo Spaceport, a port village with docking bays, houses, a marketplace, and at least one [[cantina]]. ==Behind the scenes== {{Quote|So, "Breakout" originally had Poe Dameron ''[…]''. He was with Kaz on the planet and initially, in our early conversations, that planet was going to be Batuu, from ''Galaxy's Edge'' and Disneyland. That land was in active development at that time and we had several conversations about incorporating it into ''Resistance'' but ultimately I think the decision was to give ''Resistance'' more of its own personality and I think there was a real fear it would be perceived as blatant product placement for theme park ''[…]''.|Stephen Melching, on the original setting of "The Missing Agent" and "Breakout"|audio=VarkanaBatuu-StevenMelching.flac|{{WookYouTube|_aRy5PWaiPY|Wookieepedia Interviews - Steven Melching (Part 1)}}}} [[File:Varkana-ConceptArt-PortExterior.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Concept art of Varkana by Andre Kirk]] Varkana debuted in "[[The Missing Agent]]," the twelfth episode of the [[Star Wars Resistance Season Two|second season]] of the animated television series ''[[Star Wars Resistance]]'' which aired on [[December 22]], [[2019]].{{DisneyPress|wdtv=1|url=disneychannel/shows/star-wars-resistance/episodes|text=Star Wars Resistance}} Prior to the episode's release, the planet was depicted, albeit unidentified, in a season trailer released on [[August 14]] of the same year.{{SWYouTube|JkJtdJKCVto|Star Wars Resistance Season 2 - Trailer (Official)|sw_url=video/disneyxd-season-2-trailer-star-wars-resistance|date=2019-08-14}} According to [[Steven Melching]], a writer for the season, the setting for "The Missing Agent" and its subsequent episode supposed to be the planet [[Batuu]]. In those conversations, the decision was made to make a new planet in order to give the series more of its own personality and avoid any perception that it was blatant product placement, as Batuu was the setting of a [[Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge|themed land]] that also premiered in 2019.{{D23|url=a-to-z/star-wars-galaxys-edge|text=Disney A to Z: Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge}} The architecture around Vargo Spaceport was designed to match the theme of an [[Wikipedia:American frontier|Old West]] outpost town. The exterior of the main hangar was specifically inspired by [[Wikipedia:Spanish missions in California|adobe Spanish missions]].{{SW|url=news/buckets-list-extra-the-missing-agent-star-wars-resistance|text=Bucket's List Extra: 6 Fun Facts from "The Missing Agent" - ''Star Wars Resistance''}} Concept art for Varkana in "The Missing Agent" and the following episode "[[Breakout]]," which aired a [[December 29|week later]], were done by [[Lucasfilm Animation]] artists [[Andre Kirk]],{{SW|url=the-missing-agent-concept-art-gallery|text=The Missing Agent Concept Art Gallery}} {{C|Slide 2}}{{SW|url=the-missing-agent-concept-art-gallery|text=The Missing Agent Concept Art Gallery}} {{C|Slide 6}}{{SW|url=the-missing-agent-concept-art-gallery|text=The Missing Agent Concept Art Gallery}} {{C|Slide 9}}{{SW|url=the-missing-agent-concept-art-gallery|text=The Missing Agent Concept Art Gallery}} {{C|Slide 11}}{{SW|url=breakout-concept-art-gallery|text="Breakout" Concept Art Gallery}} {{C|Slide 5}}{{SW|url=breakout-concept-art-gallery|text="Breakout" Concept Art Gallery}} {{C|Slide 10}} [[Stephan A.
